The '''Tetso Shopping Worlds''' were a group of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] located within the [[Tetso system/Legends|Tetso system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that was known as the [[Arrowhead]].<ref name="Region" /> In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Mi]] expressed interest in visiting the Tetso Shopping Worlds.<ref name="SWA" />
